Message:
I have a family I’m proud of.
A brother gifted at hunting,
and a mother everyone relies on.

But, unlike them,
I have no wings and no beak.

All I do have are horns on my head
that aren’t good for anything...

“You can’t fly,
so you could never be my sister!”

Brother jeered,
laughing down at me.
But, he was right.
After all, I don’t look
anything like him...

Catching what he said,
Mother scolded Brother.

Though when I said that,
Mother continued,
as if finding fault with me too...

“But listen, Cu Sith...
you must decide
who you are for yourself.

Otherwise, you will remain
a nestling forever.”

Mother only narrowed
her eyes sadly though, and said,
“You must figure
that out for yourself,”
before flying off into the distance...
